title: PBA: Magnolia whips Ginebra to clinch Group B quarterfinal spot

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Magnolia became the first team in a tight Group B to secure its place in the quarterfinals of the PBA Governors’ Cup after blowing out sibling rival Barangay Ginebra anew, 112-93, on Sunday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The latest chapter of the derby dubbed as “Manila Clasico” became another mismatch as the Hotshots gained control early and did not take their foot off the gas pedal to extend their winning streak to five games.
